name: side-panel
description: Panes beside the transcript of the sessions you name: status (open pull requests, each new head with a Review button, sections your own command prints, and what runs on a remote host over ssh), aws (time left on an SSO login) and today (merged today, heads waiting for a first review); keys 1-4 switch tabs.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: A regular expression of the session names that show the pane: the name czw sets in CZW_SESSION (or the session's title, where the engine passes one). Empty shows it in every session.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: The repositories whose open pull requests the pane lists, as owner/name separated by spaces. Empty lists none.

reviewed.title: Review comment
reviewed.description: A regular expression (case-insensitive) a pull request comment must match, beside naming the head's short SHA, for that head to count as reviewed (for example Verdict|Review). Empty counts any reviewer's comment that names the head. A pattern that does not compile is matched as plain text.

reviewers.title: Reviewers
reviewers.description: The GitHub logins whose comments and reviews count as reviews, separated by spaces. Empty means your own login, as gh is logged in.

review_prompt.title: Review prompt
review_prompt.description: What Review sends to the session, once it is idle, as if you typed it. {repo}, {number}, {sha} and {title} are filled in; {title} is written by whoever opened the pull request, so use it only for repositories whose authors you trust.
review_prompt.default: Review {repo}#{number} at head {sha} and post the verdict on the pull request, naming the head.

sections.title: Sections command
sections.description: A command whose output the pane shows below the pull requests: a line starting with ## is a heading; a line starting with ● is shown red, ✓ green, ⠋ blue. Empty shows none.

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: The AWS SSO profile whose login the aws tab watches: time left, red 30 minutes before it expires, and a button that queues aws sso login for it in owner-queue. Empty is management.

remote.title: Remote host
remote.description: An ssh host (or ~/.ssh/config alias) whose Claude sessions, their subagent runs and your remote command the status tab shows, read over one read-only ssh call per refresh (BatchMode, so it needs a key or Tailscale SSH). Empty shows none.

remote_label.title: Remote heading
remote_label.description: The heading of the remote section, for example Desktop. Empty uses the host.

remote_sections.title: Remote sections command
remote_sections.description: A command run on the remote host (bash, login shell) whose output shows in the remote section, in the sections format: ## headings; a line starting with ● red, ✓ green, ⠋ blue. Empty shows none.

every.title: Refresh (seconds)
every.description: How often the pane reads GitHub and the sections command; under 15 means 60.
